content.title: Structural Consistency
content.description: Seedance 2.0 eliminates the 'morphing' effect seen in older AI. Characters and environments stay solid and recognizable from start to finish.

content.title: Advanced Camera Control
content.description: Command professional cinematic techniques like drone fly-throughs, orbit shots, and macro-tracking via simple conversational prompts.

content.title: Commercial-Ready Rights
content.description: Every video generated with Seedance 2.0 on Lovart includes full commercial usage rights, ensuring your brand stays safe and professional.

items.answer: Да. Все сгенерированные видео включают коммерческие права.
